import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_program',p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def parse_grid(block, rows, cols):
    vals=[]
    for line in block.strip().splitlines():
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)==cols and all(x.isdigit() for x in parts):
            vals.append([int(x) for x in parts])
    if len(vals)!=rows:
        raise ValueError(f'expected {rows} rows, got {len(vals)}')
    return vals
results=[]

    gi=parse_grid(inp_block,h,w)
    go=parse_grid(out_block,oh,ow)
    got=mod.transform(gi)
    results.append((int(task_num), got==go, (len(got),len(got[0])), (oh,ow)))
